notes: Added missing stories to complete schema/contract, core logic hardening, API integration, and test coverage.

change_log.note: Adds explicit schema layer for tool routing
Ensures backend entrypoint uses router consistently

stories.title: Tool Input/Output Schema Contracts
stories.description: Define and enforce consistent Pydantic schemas for all tool inputs and normalized outputs, ensuring the router validates inputs and standardizes responses across provider search, clinical trials, consent, and unknown question flows.

stories.title: Allowlist Enforcement Core Logic Hardening
stories.description: Enhance tool_router core logic to strictly enforce allowlist behavior, including rejection of unknown tools, prevention of dynamic execution paths, and deterministic mapping between tool_use blocks and registered handlers.

stories.title: FastAPI Integration with Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate the tool router into the FastAPI main agent loop to ensure all tool calls from the LLM are routed through the allowlist and validation layer, including proper handling of Anthropic tool_use blocks and chat history injection.

stories.title: Comprehensive Tool Router Test Expansion
stories.description: Expand unit and integration tests to cover allowlist enforcement, schema validation failures, successful tool execution paths, and Anthropic tool_use parsing, ensuring deterministic and secure behavior under all supported scenarios.
